steps.description: Query the 'List of Foods' API to retrieve a list of vegan dishes suitable for a dinner party.
Select a recommended vegan dish from the retrieved list.
Fetch a detailed recipe for the selected vegan dish, including ingredients, method, and an image of the final dish.
